title: Aqualung
description: The recipe combines glass, a nautilus shell and a turtle scute to create a useful diving item for long underwater trips.
body:
# Aqualung


Aqualung adds a simple underwater breathing item for Minecraft.
The Aqualung is worn in the head armor slot and greatly extends the time you can stay underwater.
**It gives an OXYGEN_BONUS of +49, which means air is consumed about 50 times slower than normal.**
This makes underwater exploration easier, while still keeping the survival feeling of vanilla Minecraft.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/LQvp6G4yGA0" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features
New wearable head slot item/block: Aqualung
Gives OXYGEN_BONUS +49
About 50x slower air consumption underwater

Includes Aqualung item resources
Includes loot table
Includes crafting recipe

## Crafting Recipe
GGG
GNG
.T.

Where:
G = Glass
N = Nautilus Shell
T = Turtle Scute

### Glass Cased Torch features


New item/block: glass_cased_torch
Torch inside a glass casing
Supports waterlogged state
Works underwater
Emits light level 14
Model, blockstate, item, lang, loot table and recipe added under the aqualung namespace

### Glass Cased Torch recipe


GGG
GTG
GGG

Where:
G = Glass
T = Torch
